title: Spanish Gazpacho
description: Refreshing cold soup originating from Andalusia, made with tomatoes and other vegetables.

ingredients.name: quaint
ingredients.notes: bread, crust removed and torn into small pieces

ingredients.name: pa
ingredients.notes: bread, crust removed and torn into small pieces

ingredients.name: amb
ingredients.notes: red wine vinegar, or to taste

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatoes, quaint, pa, amb, and tomaquet until smooth.
2. With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the water until the desired consistency is reached.
3. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
4. Chill the gazpacho in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
5. Serve cold, garnished with olive oil and crusty bread if desired.
